facts.who: Maddox 与众 biker（处理 Caleb 遗体）
facts.what: 为免警方发现后院埋尸而让所有人面临指控，Caleb 的遗体被人从后院挖出，裹进蓝毯子放在柴棚旁，上面摆着孩子们种下的花。
facts.anchor: Had he been found by police, buried in the backyard, the risk was too high that we would all face charges

facts.what: Sarah 天亮循感应走进柴棚，看见 Maddox 背对她坐在椅上反复挥刀捅刺牧师尸体，脚下血泊成片。
facts.anchor: So much blood pooled at Johnny’s feet that my imagination went wild.

facts.what: Sarah 对他说 I swear it, Maddox，他失声震动 You know my name.——她点破了 Johnny 隐瞒多年的真名，兽形随之褪去、男孩回归。
facts.anchor: This time, he sucked in air. His dark voice eased from its harshness and cracked. “You know my name.”

facts.what: Kristen 摊牌后果：两名警察将被发现被谋杀、两名寄养家长死亡、五名在册寄养儿童失踪——意味着告别棒球奖学金、高中毕业、加州与原本身份。
facts.anchor: Listen, two cops will be found murdered. Two foster parents deceased. And five registered foster children MIA.

facts.what: Styx 交给 Sarah 一张可安全使用的信用卡，叮嘱只用他改装过、无法被追踪的笔记本下单，收件地址为 P.O. Box zero-four-nine-nine，并说追查者会先搜中国。
facts.anchor: They will search China first. Mail the stuff to P.O. Box zero-four-nine-nine…

facts.what: 深夜 Misfits 乘黑色 SUV 赶到海岸（最后 10%）；车一停 Maddox 全速冲向水中等候的 Saleeni，众人在月光下见证两人相拥亲吻。
facts.anchor: Maddox jumped out and ran full-speed toward the water, the gentle waves, and the one waiting for him

facts.what: 结尾（最后 10%）：为保 Saleeni 安全并送 Caleb 回新家，Maddox 被迫离开众人先行走——那个新家将是众人日后都要归去的地方。
facts.anchor: Maddox was forced to leave us behind. He had to keep Saleeni safe and take Caleb to his new home.

facts.what: 结尾（最后 10%）：其余 Misfits 被迫迁往新地点——Noma 多年前为掩护孙子换藏身处设下的备用方案；众人昂首以身为 Maddox 的 Saltbone Sinners 为荣。
facts.anchor: the backup plan Noma had set in place long ago, in case her grandson needed a new area to hide
